scope: EXTERNAL SYNTHETIC RESEARCH ONLY; not official model training or accepted evidence
question: Can sequential sparse high-order Fourier factor discovery recover held 4/5-way causal relations with strong old-context retention and lower out-of-distribution prediction error than fully trained conventional learners on unfamiliar parity, threshold and conditional/modulo generators?
hypothesis: The proposed learner recovers >=60% of exact 4/5-way parity supports, keeps old predictions intact, achieves >=10% lower cold MSE than strongest conventional, and does so stably and economically.

data.origin: Fresh self-authored synthetic do-interventions, not protected first-use or real-world data
data.generator: SHA256 keyed E51:v1; 10 hidden causal action bits and two observed nuisance bits; 5 signed factors (3 shared, 1 old-only, 1 new-only) on first 10; Gaussian consequence noise sigma .25; nuisance correlation shifts old/new/cold; evaluation true supports and hidden held outcomes never supplied during fitting
data.planted_factors: 4/5-bit parity; 5-bit majority/threshold; modulo 3; conditional gate. Hidden operators/signed coefficients not supplied to learner.
data.grammar_limit: All Walsh parity monomials degree 1..5 on all 12 observed action bits, 1585 preauthored features, available to feature-based controls. Not unrestricted causal-operator invention.
data.assignment_provenance: 360 unique 10-bit causal assignments per world, disjoint across 72 old train/72 new train/72 held old/72 held new/72 held cold.

methods.candidate: Frozen old six-term degree-penalized greedy sparse Fourier learner plus five-term new residual corrective learner, degree penalty factor (1+.045*(degree-1)), ridge .02, stop score<.03; corrections only on new/cold; source code defines fitting and prediction exactly.
controls: Fully trained separate-context sklearn OMP6 over same Walsh dictionary
Fully trained separate-context ElasticNet alpha .035 l1 .85 max_iter 1100 tol .0005 over full Walsh dictionary
Fully trained independent old/new KernelRidge RBF alpha .20 gamma .30 raw actions
Fully trained old/new polynomial KernelRidge degree5 alpha .25 gamma 1/12 coef0 1
Fully trained old/new ExtraTrees 64 trees depth12 min_leaf2 raw actions
methods.information: All methods receive identical 72 old + 72 new factual witnessed labels, and no held label, true support, model checkpoint or third-party API. Controls can have different capacity, reported explicitly. No active intervention selection.
methods.compute: 36 primary worlds, one unchanged-source replay, independent auditor re-fits every arm. CPU single-thread NumPy 2.3.5, scikit-learn 1.8.0, SciPy 1.17.0, Python3.13.5. Per-arm time = fit and 3 held-predict times, not full machine work or Joules.
methods.metric: Per-world and aggregate noisy held outcome MSE on 72 old/new/cold disjoint actions; exact high-order parity support recall ignores non-parity planted rules; seed and family cold comparisons.

frozen_gates.cold_10pct_better_than_best_conventional: candidate aggregate cold MSE <=0.9x best mean conventional cold MSE
frozen_gates.higher_order_parity_recall_60pct: candidate exact selected 4/5 parity feature support overlap with planted parity >=60%
frozen_gates.old_frozen_retention_exact: candidate old MSE equals identical no-adapt frozen old MSE within 1e-10
frozen_gates.new_no_worse_than_best_conventional_5pct: candidate new MSE <=1.05x best conventional new MSE
frozen_gates.cold_at_least_20pct_better_than_shuffled: candidate cold MSE <=.8x shuffled new-outcome learner cold MSE
frozen_gates.seed_stability_2_of_3: candidate cold MSE strictly below best separate conventional within >=2 of 3 seeds
frozen_gates.cost_below_2x_separate_omp: candidate measured fit+predict time <=2x conventional OMP6 fit+predict time
frozen_gates.cold_vs_new_degradation_at_most_20pct: candidate cold MSE <=1.2x own new MSE
frozen_gates.every_family_at_most_10pct_worse_than_be: candidate family cold MSE <=1.1x strongest conventional within EACH family

decision.development_go: All 9 gates PASS and independent audit PASS; this is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS
decision.development_no_go: Any gate FAIL with valid source, held isolation, label parity and independent audit
decision.invalid: Prereg after primary, source mismatch, split/held leakage, missing control, invalid score, missing independently verified full receipts or audit failure
decision.primary_lock: After scoring no tuning seeds, metrics, thresholds, data, capacities or posthoc preferred subsets.
decision.no_promotion: No native training, accepted-ref mutation, controller/scheduler/runner/queue activity, merge, autonomous loop promotion, deployment.

source_status: Pinned independent scorer and auditor committed at source SHA before prereg, excluded smoke passed; primary seeds not yet scored.
